title: eat shit & die 158
author: bpatrick
body: This is about the fifth version of this comic I’ve done. I almost gave up but I think it turned out OK. I had the idea nailed I just couldn’t bring it into being – as it were.

comments.author: Eb0la
comments.text:
It works great ! Very good, you have brilliant ideas.
I already told you on drawingboard that I love your style, so much expressiveness. Keep it up.
I just love your girls 🙂

comments.author: Jada
comments.text: Spent the last few days reading through your archive. I really enjoy your stuff, both serious and humorous. Glad to see an update. 🙂

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text:
Thanks Eb0la! I’ve been unhappy with my girls lately. They can be better.
Thanks Jada! I love hearing that people have read through the archives – just in case my best work is behind me.

comments.author: Eb0la
comments.text:
I hope your best work isn’t gay then.
Your girls are just fine.

comments.author: Joe bob
comments.text: Ha , I used to live there also but I escaped

comments.author: Rich
comments.text: the sad thing is, trent’s room looks like like mine. Right down to the empty beer cans and cigarettes.

comments.author: Artez
comments.text: Hey, do you make prints of your stuff?

comments.author: kuddos
comments.text:
I’ve been reading your comics for a couple of weeks now, two or three every morning starting from the newest, and this my man… I think is one of best of all!
Is hard to pick just one, you have a lot of very good ideas.
Love your work.
